description: Look up Italian comuni by name (case- and accent-insensitive, partial names work) and get each one's 6-digit ISTAT code, province and region — the code get_comune needs. Returns identifiers only, no figures. Several comuni share a name; check the province before choosing.

limit.description: How many matches to return, 1–25. Default 10.

q.description: A comune name or part of one, accents optional — e.g. "Introdacqua" or "reggio".

name: search_comuni
title: Find a comune by name
